Partnering with and flying your skyscale is a dance that requires the utmost care. As your instructor will surely share with you, success requires patience, concentration, and—most critically—pure willpower. Before you take flight in the skies above the archipelago, commit these five principles to heart:  
  
1. Keep this manual on your person at all times.   
  
2. Use gentle motions and movements when directing your skyscale. There is no need to sever a scale from the noble beast's body because the need to turn slipped your mind.  
   
3. Observe all posted height restrictions and flying debris warnings.  
  
4. While accelerating might be fun, braking could save your life. You can tell your skyscale to slow down by—

### Nayos Stew (serves 6–8)

## Ingredients:

- 2 lb. skitterer thorax meat
- 1 lb. potatoes
- 1 lb. spiderbrush tubers
- Salt and pepper from ration packs (to taste)

## Steps:

1. Peel the chitin off the thorax meat and wash thoroughly (you'll know you're done when the water stops turning purple).
2. Combine ingredients in pot and cook over low heat for 6–8 hours.

Make sure to monitor soldiers eating it for the first time in case of allergic reactions!

Seekers of the Navarium Core, 
  
Only those who have attained the doyen's most sacred trust, who have stood within the Empyreal Threshold, quelled the All Seer, and who have performed rites at the Dome of the Indelible Word, will possess the imbuements necessary to read the true words of this sacred writ. To the uninitiated, the tablet will appear to describe the mundane qualities of seer architectural techniques.  
  
The reason for these measures is to safeguard the location of our people's most important site on Castora, which must remain a closely guarded secret. While Castora itself is, as you have no doubt experienced for yourself, a locale that is steeped in the powerful magic of Tyria's ley lines and nature spirits, there is a source of power greater than any that our people have ever encountered.  
  
While there are known confluences of ley lines across Tyria, what may not be common knowledge is that there are even more powerful upflows of Tyria's innate magic scattered across the planet, each one hidden deep underground.  
  
These "ley roots," as we have called them, are places where one can bathe in the primal power of the planet itself. In most cases, these sites remain out of reach because these natural "springs" of ley energy have become the resting places for the Elder Dragons.  
  
The presence of those immensely powerful beings has made it all but impossible for any of the elder species of Tyria to study these incredible upwellings. However, for reasons unknown to us, the ley root beneath Castora has remained untouched for millennia...which gives our people a unique advantage.  
  
If you wish to learn more, your next step should be to consult Gardesano, who can almost always be found within the ateliers of the forge.
